newsitem.title: USA: Rubin hails CBOT trading of indexed securities.
newsitem.headline: Rubin hails CBOT trading of indexed securities.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said the Chicago Board of Trade has initiated trading in futures contracts of inflation-indexed securities, hailing it as a step toward developing a market for the fledgling securities.

"This is a long-term project for us," Rubin said in a statement. "Today's introduction of inflation-indexed futures contracts will facilitate trading in indexed securities and thus is an important step in this process."
Treasury has sold $15 billion of 10-year notes that are indexed to protect investors against inflation and will sell $8 billion of five-year indexed notes next Wednesday.
